Hey guys! There is a change I would like to see in the Voat mindset that I have noticed this past week. Let me tell a short story to exemplify this.

I am a musician, and I generally only make posts to either /v/Voat or /v/Music. These are the two areas where I know what I'm talking about. This past week, I have made two posts and will be making one tonight. All of these will be self promotion of my music. However, I don't think this is as bad as people seem to view it. If I had made original comic strips, or taken original photographs, the community would have eaten them up. However, when its my own personal music there seems to be a problem. My posts weren't just music though. They were:

1) A blog post I had written on Monday about weather or not music can be objectively good. I posted a link to the blog and had a great discussion with you guys about that topic.

2) A follow up video that I made about criteria by which I think music could be objectively measured. Unfortunately, there was not much a discussion on that one, but I was hoping for it.

3) Tonight, I will be posting an original music video of mine.

Now, all of these things are self promotion, and so are all of my posts. I have received quite a bit of flack for this. They are also the epitome of original content. I think Voat needs to be much more open to original content. Would you rather I copy 5 links from Reddit in between each of my original works just so I am not purely sharing content that I have actually worked hard on? Even though I was bringing people to my website and YouTube channel, these things fostered great discussions with the community on this website. So long as the user isn't posting and running, I think self promotion is the best thing for voat, be it bloggers, YouTubers, photographers, or comic makers.

I believe that Self Promotion needs to be addressed on a case by case basis. If the user is fostering genuine discussion and quality content, I say let them post the cool stuff they are making! THAT is what is going to make Voat hit its maximum potential. I agree the users that spam their blog and never respond to comments is not what the community needs, but if that same user created quality blog posts and had good discussions with Voat, I think it would be extremely valuable to the community.

I invite you to put me under the microscope and look at my former posts. You will find that they are all self promotion. You will also find that about 2/3 of my posts are discussion based (regardless of weather or not that discussion actually happened), while 1/3 of my posts are of just my music. Ask yourself what you want on Voat, true original content, or shared links from Reddit?

I also am open to being wrong here. If you think Voat would be better if I shared other people's content in between mine, I will do so. I want what is best for the community and I have shared my opinion on that. However, I do hope this community can become much more open to self promotion when it is of a certain quality and allow Voat to become a hub of the coolest original content on the internet.

Thanks for reading guys! Lets make this site great!
